verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; creative refresh and intake fix are underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 102 leads at an average cost of $7.35 per lead, but the most recent 7 days tell a harder story: leads fell 34.5% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat, pushing cost per lead up 49.4%. The single active campaign has been running to a retargeting-only audience, and that pool is showing clear signs of exhaustion — the same people have been seeing the same creative for too long. Separately, Google Business Profile engagement dropped 61.7% this week, which reduces the flow of new contacts into that retargeting audience and compounds the paid decline. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to break the fatigue cycle, and we are also addressing a gap in lead intake: 102 leads arrived this period but none converted to an appointment, which points to a follow-up process issue rather than an ads problem — that is being investigated now.
